summary: Iter 21 — Seeded Yankees/WFAN & Morning Market Brief presets, Morning automation, UniFi Protect person-alert webhook/alerts, and offline banner. Backend pytest 14/14 PASS. Frontend 390x844 (demo bypass): Home shows pinned-preset_yankees_wfan button and running it logs the correct WS66i commands + Linkplay WFAN entry (toast 'Scene: Yankees on WFAN'). Scenes tab lists both new presets with scene-edit-* pencils (preset-edit-* testid not used — actual is scene-edit-*). Automations section (inside Scenes tab) shows automation-row-auto_morning_brief with text 'Morning Market Brief · weekdays 8:00 · 08:00 · M T W T F → Morning Market Brief'. Settings → UniFi Protect Camera: toggling settings-live-camera (LIVE) reveals person-webhook card with person-webhook-url containing /api/protect/webhook/, person-webhook-copy-btn, person-test-btn, person-webhook-rotate-btn. With Security disarmed → clicking person-test-btn shows toast 'Arm Security first to see the alert' and NO modal. With Security armed → modal person-alert appears within ~5s with person-alert-title 'Person at Front Entry', camera player visible; person-alert-close-btn dismisses it and polling (4s) does NOT re-open it for the same alert id (seen stored in localStorage c4_person_seen). Offline banner: hidden normally. Seeded db.system.offline_alerts=[{id:'tv_office',name:'Office TV',ip:'192.168.0.177',since:4min ago}] → Home shows offline-banner 'Office TV is offline' with '(192.168.0.177) · 4 min' subtitle; clicking opens device-health-panel. No horizontal overflow at 390px (scrollWidth-clientWidth=0). Backend: GET /api/scenes includes preset_yankees_wfan (tunein_station wfan/stream_a + 4x amp_source airplay + 4x amp_volume 40 across audio_living/office/master/bathroom) and preset_morning_brief (tunein_station s165740/stream_b + amp_source airplay2/audio_office + amp_volume 20/audio_office). state.pinned_scenes contains preset_yankees_wfan. GET /api/automations has auto_morning_brief enabled with schedule 08:00 days [1,2,3,4,5] → action.scene_id=preset_morning_brief. POST /api/scene/preset_yankees_wfan logs Linkplay (WFAN/TuneIn) + WS66i <11CH03 <12CH03 <13CH03 <14CH03 + volume 40. Webhook: POST /api/protect/webhook/<wrong> → 404 (public, no auth needed). With correct token from state.config.camera.webhook_token and Security disarmed → {alerted:false}. After POST /api/security/arm {enabled:true} → person trigger → {alerted:true} and GET /api/alerts shows person_alert (auth required: 401 without Bearer). Non-person trigger key 'vehicle' → {ignored:true}. POST /api/protect/test-person (auth required, 401 without) armed → {alerted:true, armed:true}. POST /api/protect/webhook-token rotates and old token → 404, new token works. End state: Security disarmed, camera live=false, offline_alerts=[], person_alert=null.
critical_code_review_comments: PersonAlert.jsx (line 7, SHOW_FOR_MS=60000): the modal auto-closes after 60s but also marks it as 'seen' in localStorage. If a user is away from the tablet when the alert fires, after 60s it is permanently dismissed with no record on screen. Consider either keeping it visible indefinitely until manually dismissed, OR surface a persistent small badge in the top bar until acknowledged. Also auto-closing counts as 'seen' — if the operator never looked, there is no way to replay the alert from UI (only /api/alerts has the raw data).

PersonAlert.jsx polls /api/alerts every 4s and the modal shows for 60s — on first mount after an unviewed alert the latency to open can be up to 4s plus the 60s cutoff is checked against (Date.now() - at). This is why the test waits 5.5s. Fine, but could be documented.

OfflineBanner.jsx: polls /api/alerts every 30s. If the operator just saw a device go offline, there is up to 30s latency before the banner appears or disappears. Acceptable, but could piggyback on the shared polling in SystemContext to avoid duplicate HTTP calls (both PersonAlert and OfflineBanner call api.alerts independently).

server.py _record_person(): when disarmed returns False silently without recording to command_log. For audit, consider logging an 'ignored (disarmed)' entry so the operator can see protect webhooks were received but suppressed.

server.py protect_webhook: swallows all JSON parse errors ('body=={}'). An empty body with no triggers currently falls through to _record_person (because `if triggers and not keys&...` requires triggers to be non-empty). So an EMPTY webhook body ALWAYS triggers a person alert when armed. Consider rejecting empty bodies with 400 or treating 'no triggers' the same as 'non-person triggers' (ignored).

server.py offline_watch runs every 60s and OFFLINE_ALERT_AFTER_S=180 — so an offline device may take up to 60+180=240s (4 min) to show on the banner. Acceptable, but worth documenting the real-world worst case (banner_text in simulation shows 'min 3').

SettingsDrawer PersonWebhook card only shows when conn.live is true (DeviceCard hides children in DEMO). The task note says 'enable LIVE to see fields' which matches the implementation, but it is non-obvious — a short helper line like 'Enable LIVE to show the webhook URL' in DEMO mode would help first-time setup.

HomeTab.jsx line 68: pinned-preset_yankees_wfan button has no visual indication of being 'pinned' (just a star icon identical to others). If more presets are pinned, differentiating pinned vs quick-scene is only by position. Low priority.
test_credentials: PIN 1234 (demo bypass used for frontend tests).
seed_data_creation: Temporarily seeded db.system.offline_alerts with one entry to verify offline-banner → cleared to [] at end. Toggled camera.live true→false and camera.armed true→false during tests → both restored. person_alert cleared. Seeded presets (preset_yankees_wfan, preset_morning_brief) and automation (auto_morning_brief) left intact as per task.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<url> python -m pytest backend/tests/test_iter21_presets_webhook.py -v -o addopts= . TestSeededPresets validates /api/scenes, /api/automations, /api/state.pinned_scenes and that running preset_yankees_wfan emits the expected Linkplay + WS66i <11CH03..<14CH03 + volume 40 entries in command_log. TestWebhook validates POST /api/protect/webhook/{token} (public, 404 on wrong, {alerted:false} when disarmed, {alerted:true} when armed + person trigger, {ignored:true} on vehicle trigger), POST /api/protect/test-person (auth), POST /api/protect/webhook-token rotation, GET /api/alerts auth gating. Note that /api/protect/webhook/<token> is PUBLIC (listed in PUBLIC_PREFIXES at server.py line 2224). Frontend testid gotchas: Scenes edit pencils are scene-edit-{id} (NOT edit-preset-{id}). Automations live inside the Scenes tab (nav-scenes), not a separate tab. PersonWebhook card only renders when settings-live-camera toggle is ON (DeviceCard hides children in DEMO). Clear localStorage.c4_person_seen before firing a new test-person to avoid being suppressed from a previous test. See potential bug: empty-body webhook with armed=true will fire a person alert — see critical_code_review_comments.
rca of the issue: No functional defects found. One potential logic concern: protect_webhook treats an empty JSON body (triggers=[]) as 'fall-through' and will fire _record_person when armed (because the `if triggers and not keys&{person,...}` guard only kicks in when triggers is non-empty). A malformed/empty webhook POST with just the correct token would therefore trigger a false person alert while armed. Suggested mitigation: require at least one trigger or treat empty-triggers as ignored.
